lines: Thus resorting to many varieties one alone which standing, venerable Khecarī; absorbed by her supreme seed attains.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ nānāvidhānbhedānāśrityaikaiva yā sthitā śrīkhecarī tayāviṣṭaḥ paraṃ bījaṃ prapadyate
